reason: The array is coated in grit, so brushing it seems like a practical first step toward restoring solar power for the station.
expectation: I expect the brush to clear the panels and improve their ability to supply power, though restarting services may require further steps.

alternatives.reason: The water line also needs restarting, but I would restore the power source first.

effect: Brushing the array produced a restored solar supply, so I can now connect it at the restart controls.
reaction: It was a straightforward, satisfying first step.
reason: Using the restored supply at the restart controls seems like the next step toward bringing essential services back online.
expectation: I expect the station to switch back to solar power, though the water line may still need a separate restart.

alternatives.reason: The water line also needs attention, but restoring the station's power supply first seems useful.

effect: The return plant is running again, but it must replace propellant lost during shutdown over the coming weeks. The water line still needs attention.
reaction: The lost propellant surprised me and made the restart feel consequential.
reason: Restarting the drained water line seems necessary to restore the station's water service.
expectation: I expect the controls to check and restore the line, though it may need to warm before water can flow.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce can return to the sunny shelf, but restoring water service seems more urgent.

effect: The line is heated, primed and supplying the tap again. Essential services are restored, so I can return the troughs to the window.
reaction: The explanation of priming the line before opening the well inlet made the restart feel practical.
reason: The lettuce trough needs to return to the window shelf, and placing it there directly advances the new goal.
expectation: I expect the lettuce trough to be placed on the shelf; the potato trough will still need to be moved.

alternatives.reason: The potato trough also needs to go back, and either move seems reasonable first.

effect: The lettuce trough is back on the window shelf, leaving the potato trough to move.
reaction: The placement was straightforward; nothing else stood out.
reason: Moving the potato trough is the only available combination and should complete the goal of returning both beds.
expectation: I expect the potato trough to be placed on the shelf and the goal to be completed.

effect: Both troughs are back on the window shelf, completing the chapter.
reaction: The final placement was straightforward; nothing else stood out.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restarting the water line was most worthwhile because the explanation showed how heating and priming restore flow before the well inlet opens.

leastWorthwhile.text: Moving the two troughs was clear but repetitive, with each placement handled separately.

surprise.text: I was surprised that some stored propellant had boiled away during the shutdown and would take weeks to replace.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the trough placements had a clear goal, even if they were predictable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the propellant loss makes me curious about the journey home, and the earlier discovery leaves me interested in what the specimens might reveal.
